name: Vilajuïga (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, the white charged in the canton with two crossed stripes of the county of Empúries, yellow and red.
history: The official flag of Vilajuïga (9 June 1995) is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided into two equal horizontal stripes, white above and blue below, with two crossed stripes of the county of Empúries in the canton.

features.role: two crossed stripes of the county of Empúries, yellow with red bars, in the canton
red bars on the crossed stripes
